// direction: terminal

Color roles

Ground and ink

Canvas--bg
Card--surface
Tinted band--surface-warm
Body ink--fg
Heading ink--fg-2
Muted--muted
Hairline--border

Accent and status

Accent--accent
Accent hover--accent-hover
Leaf--accent-secondary
Operational--success
Degraded--warn
Outage--danger

Surface treatments

Line grid--grid on --bg
Footer ground--chrome-elevated

The status trio is direction independent and is not remapped in dark: a green operational dot has to stay green in the indigo and cyan colourways. The accent, the grounds and the hairline are the values that move.
